newsitem.title: UK: Quadramatic up on profit rise, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Quadramatic up on profit rise, outlook.

text.p: Shares in British coin handling equipment manufacturer Quadramatic Plc rose sharply on Thursday after the company announced a 30 percent increase in annual pre-tax profit and said business would continue to expand.
The shares were up 20-1/2p at 244p by 1014 GMT, while the broader market was weak. Some 35,800 shares had changed hands.
"We look forward to continuing the exciting growth that has been achieved over the past three years," chairman Tony McCann said in a statement accompanying the results.
He said the company would continue to introduce new products and expand internationally.
Quadramatic posted an annual pretax profit in the year ended September 30 of 13.01 million stg against 10.01 million the previous year.
The company's total dividend was up 14.1 percent at 18.6p, while turnover rose 35 percent to 62.31 million stg.
Quadramatic said the results reflected further organic growth supplemented by the integration of two companies, Hampton Mouldings Group Ltd and Controls and Automation Ltd.
